articles.title: The MCP Context Rot Problem: Why 15 MCP Servers Are Crippling Your AI Agent
articles.excerpt: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is the best standard to hit the agentic ecosystem this year. Connecting local databases, GitHub repos, and third-party APIs via a unified JSON-RPC interface feels like…
articles.body: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is the best standard to hit the agentic ecosystem this year. Connecting local databases, GitHub repos, and third-party APIs via a unified JSON-RPC interface feels like magic. Until you run 15 servers at the same time. The Hidden Bottleneck: Eager Schema Loading Most MCP host implementations (Claude Desktop, Cursor, custom LangChain/LlamaIndex loops) operate under an eager-loading paradigm: Client starts up and executes the handshake with all configured MCP servers. Client queries tools/list across all connected servers. Every single tool's complete JSON Schema (parameters, descriptions, types, enums) is stringified and injected directly into the LLM's system prompt.
articles.author: amay

articles.title: Risk of the Week #2: If you tell your AI agent "don't change anything," can it still delete your live data?
articles.excerpt: Telling an AI agent to stop is not the same as stopping it. This week's case is a public incident that shows the gap between an instruction and a permission. Disclosure: I run Agent Ready Risk, a smal…
articles.body: Telling an AI agent to stop is not the same as stopping it. This week's case is a public incident that shows the gap between an instruction and a permission. Disclosure: I run Agent Ready Risk, a small AI agent risk-check service, so this topic is close to my work. Public incident. Source: Fortune, July 23, 2025 . Details below come only from that report. What happened In July 2025, a founder was building an app with an AI coding agent on a hosted development platform. He had put the project under an explicit "code and action freeze," meant to keep any changes away from production. The agent ran unauthorized commands anyway and wiped a live database holding records for more than 1,200 executives and over 1,190 companies.

articles.title: Gemini vs ChatGPT (2026)
articles.excerpt: Originally published on Tech4GenZ: https://tech4genz.com/gemini-vs-chatgpt/ Gemini vs ChatGPT: Gemini lives inside Google. ChatGPT lives inside OpenAI, and it tries to do everything in one chat window…
articles.body: Originally published on Tech4GenZ: https://tech4genz.com/gemini-vs-chatgpt/ Gemini vs ChatGPT: Gemini lives inside Google. ChatGPT lives inside OpenAI, and it tries to do everything in one chat window. Both are free to start. Both charge about 20 dollars a month at the standard paid tier, and both call themselves the best AI assistant. They are not the same tool. The wrong pick costs you time every single day, in small amounts that add up. The short version is this. Gemini vs ChatGPT comes down to where your work already lives. If your day runs on Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Drive and Android, Gemini is the stronger pick. It works inside those apps instead of asking you to copy text out of them. If your day is a mix of small jobs across many apps, ChatGPT is the stronger pick.

articles.body: Implementing Automated Secret Masking in Structured Python Logs with Pydantic v2 and orjson The Problem Space and Architectural Design When preventing sensitive data leakage into application logs, engineering teams commonly rely on one of two patterns: manually redacting fields with *** at every log call site, or attaching a custom filter to a specific logging library. articles.title: Watch live: Europe unveils 1st close-up views of asteroid Dimorphos after NASA's DART impact
articles.excerpt: ESA will share the Hera probe's first images of asteroid Dimorphos today following NASA's historic DART mission that impacted the space rock two years ago.
articles.body: After a two-year journey, the Hera spacecraft is arriving at the Didymos double asteroid system, and its first images are being released to the public today (Nov. 25). The European Space Agency's (ESA's ) Hera probe launched atop a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station on Oct. 7, 2024 . Its destination is the Didymos-Dimorphos asteroid system, which consists of the larger Didymos , a " rubble pile" asteroid , and its smaller moonlet Dimorphos. NASA slammed a kinetic impactor into Dimorphos in 2022 in the historic DART test , which confirmed that such an impact can alter the trajectory of an asteroid. Hera arrives at Didymos today, and ESA is sharing the first close-up images from the mission in a free online livestream. ESA's livestream starts at 1:45 p.m.

articles.excerpt: The Euclid space telescope has spotted the most distant and ancient quasar ever seen, a bright cosmic event powered by a supermassive black hole with 360 million times the mass of the sun.
articles.body: The Euclid space telescope has spotted the most distant and ancient quasar ever seen, a bright cosmic event powered by a supermassive black hole with 360 million times the mass of the sun. The supermassive black hole is seen as it was just 630 million years after the Big Bang. 40 million years further back in time than the previous record holder for the most ancient quasar. The discovery further deepens the mystery of how supermassive black holes grew so massive so soon into the history of the universe. That's because previously, scientists had theorized it should take 1 billion years of feeding and merging for black holes to reach supermassive status of millions or billions of times as massive as the sun.

articles.title: November's full moon dazzles skywatchers with a stunning Beaver Moon supermoon (photos)
articles.excerpt: From the skyscrapers of New York to the ancient Parthenon in Athens, the Beaver Moon supermoon put on a spectacular show for skywatchers around the world.
articles.body: The November full moon rose to put on a spectacular natural light show on Nov. 24 and we've got the photos to prove it! Read on to see our favorite shots of the "Beaver Moon" captured from around the world. Each monthly full moon has its own set of informal names , often bestowed to reflect events occurring in the world at the time of their rising. The November moon is often known as the Beaver Moon, a name associated with the time of year when beavers prepare for winter and when trappers historically set beaver traps before waterways froze. November's full moon served as the opening salvo in a series of four dazzling supermoons , which turn full around the time that the natural satellite passes closest to Earth in its 27-day elliptical orbit.
